apply.title: Become a coach
apply.subtitle: Fill in your profile. An admin will review it, and once it's approved you'll be able to set your available times.
apply.reviewNote: If you change your sport, description or rate later, your profile will be reviewed again.

PENDING.title: Your application is pending
PENDING.description: You'll be notified as soon as an admin reviews it.

APPROVED.title: Your profile is approved
APPROVED.description: If you change your sport, description or rate, your profile will be reviewed again.

REJECTED.title: Your application was rejected
REJECTED.description: Update your profile and send it again.

form.rateHint: An indicative rate shown in the list. You'll set the price of each session in your available times.
form.certificationsPlaceholder: e.g. Tennis coaching diploma, level B

admin.title: Coach approval
admin.subtitle: Review coach profiles before they go public.

PENDING.title: No pending applications
PENDING.description: When someone applies to be a coach, you'll find it here.

APPROVED.title: No approved coaches
APPROVED.description: Coaches you approve will show up here.

REJECTED.title: No rejected applications
REJECTED.description: Applications you reject will show up here.

actions.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The description is too short.
